decisions.reason: The approved higher-power PWM controllers and 50A adapter are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; no additional update or removal is required.
Selecting a 50A AC/DC adapter and higher-power controllers does not replace or alter the requirement to power Prototype V1 from a standard 120V wall outlet.
The approved electrical capacity components do not change the established motor speed range or intended mixing-speed modes.
The electrical capacity decision does not alter bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or enclosure-size constraints.
Preventing electrical overheating through additional capacity does not change the separate requirement to prevent liquid from reaching electrical components.
The approved power-supply and controller capacities do not modify the existing splash-control target or permitted mechanical mitigations.
The electrical capacity decision supports the system but does not change the required mixing, foam, whisk, or high-speed performance outcomes.
Approval of specific BOM components does not change the existing strategy of using off-the-shelf electronics for Prototype V1.
The source approves component purchases but does not change the requirement to provide a basic wiring plan or specify a new wiring-plan attribute.
Although the electrical system must support the solenoids, the approved capacity components do not change the dispensing mechanism, sequence, or flow behavior.
Reserve electrical capacity intended to prevent system overheating does not modify the separate motor-duty requirement against constant maximum-speed operation.
The electrical capacity decision has no effect on the DJ-turntable visual theme.
